title: Letter of Albert Einstein to the Lieutenant Stephen Brunauer, U.S. Navy Bureau of Ordnance

alt_text: Letter of Albert Einstein to the Lieutenant Stephen Brunauer, U.S. Navy Bureau of Ordnance, 1943-05-17. It is in regards to Albert Einstein participating in the Research and Development Division of the Navy to research Navy problems.
notes: One of the nine Brunauer letters (series NAID 305246, EIN-S-0040; EIN-F-0062, EIN-F-0063); EIN-M-0015 is the 1943-06-18 letter. Supports EIN-F-0064. 2 page images in the catalog record. Princeton room / Stop 6 (Navy work); place of writing not stated by the record. NARA useRestriction.status 'Unrestricted' (approved rights rule).

title: Letter from Albert Einstein, Chairman of the Emergency Committee of Atomic Scientists
credit: National Archives at College Park, Records of the Foreign Service Posts of the Department of State, NAID 7873452.
alt_text: Letter from Albert Einstein, Chairman of the Emergency Committee of Atomic Scientists, 1947-10-11. In it, Albert Einstein wrote on behalf of the Emergency Committee of Atomic Scientists regarding questions, topics, and warnings concerning the use of nuclear or atomic resources as a means for diplomatic or military solutions.
notes: Companion of EIN-M-0016 (1947-11-29). Supports EIN-F-0079, EIN-F-0080. Two page images (27281-2013-001/002-ac.jpg, about 9.3 and 7.6 MB). Conscience constellation, Princeton room. NARA 'Unrestricted' (approved rights rule).
